C. METHODOLOGY NOTES (to be published with the report)
A 'No' on action is not an absence of impact

Q5 asks only about substantial action — a collaboration, pilot, funding, partnership or decision. Q6 captures effects that never became a project. Always read the two together, and never report the Q5 No rate on its own.
Perception shift is a retrospective matched pair

Both the 'before' and 'today' ratings are given in the same conversation, so the delta is respondent recall on a matched scale, not a measured before/after. Report it as a shift respondents describe, and state that the baseline was collected after the fact.
No single question is asked of every respondent about staying connected, so report named connections rather than a percentage.
Attribution sits inside a multi-part open answer, topped up by an optional post-close tap. Report it as a split of the responses that carry it, and state the base.
Timing is respondent-recalled and partially captured

Timing and durability sit on the post-close screen, not in the conversation. They are recalled rather than verified, and only respondents who complete that screen supply them. Treat the timeline as indicative of pattern, and state the base.
~800 to 1,000 invited; 150 to 250 completions expected. Respondents who collaborated are likelier to reply, so collaboration rates skew high.
Future-readiness findings represent 150 to 250 senior education leaders. They are not a sector-wide or population-level view.
